steps.promotion_criteria: Direct recruitment through MPESB Written Examination and Physical Efficiency Walking Test, followed by basic forester training at Forest Guard Training Schools.
steps.source_label: MPESB Van Rakshak & Kshetra Rakshak Rulebook 2026, Section 2

steps.promotion_criteria: Promotion on seniority-cum-fitness basis after 5 to 7 years of field service in beat protection and anti-poaching operations, subject to passing departmental examinations.
steps.source_label: Madhya Pradesh Subordinate Forest Service Recruitment Rules

steps.promotion_criteria: Promotion through Departmental Promotion Committee (DPC) after ~5 years service as Vanpal, or through limited departmental competitive examination.
steps.source_label: MP Forest Department Executive Service Cadre Structure

steps.promotion_criteria: Promotion through MPPSC DPC based on merit-cum-seniority and mandatory completion of Range Officer training at State Forest Academy.
steps.source_label: MP State Forest Service Gazetted Rules

steps.designation: Assistant Conservator of Forests (ACF / सहायक वन संरक्षक)
steps.promotion_criteria: Induction into MP State Forest Service (Class II Gazetted) by promotion quota after 6 to 10 years of exemplary service as Forest Ranger.

papers.paper_name: Combined Test: General Knowledge, General Hindi, General English, General Mathematics, General Science

official_perks.perk_description: Dearness Allowance computed at the rate of 58% of basic pay (₹11,310 per month at entry level).
Rent-free forest beat accommodation / inspection hutment or HRA between 8% to 16% of basic pay.
official_perks.source_label: MP Forest Department Quarters Allotment Rules

official_perks.perk_description: Annual uniform upkeep and kit allowance for operational field duties in forest ranges.
Special compensatory allowance and ration allowance for wilderness patrolling and wildlife sanctuary posting.
Contributory Defined Pension Scheme with 14% matching contribution by the state government.
